authenticity.note: FederalRegister.gov is used for structured metadata; binding legal reliance must be verified against the official Federal Register edition.

notes: Proposes to revise diagnostic code 7009, Bradycardia (Bradyarrhythmia), to provide a minimum 10 percent evaluation after pacemaker implantation, aligning DC 7009 with DC 7018, Implantable cardiac pacemakers, and to remove Note (1) under DC 7009.

impact.summary: Proposed rating-schedule change for DC 7009, Bradycardia (Bradyarrhythmia): a minimum 10 percent evaluation after pacemaker implantation, aligning DC 7009 with DC 7018, and removal of Note (1) under DC 7009. Comments closed 2026-03-31 and no final rule has been published as of 2026-09-01, so current rating criteria under 38 CFR 4.104 remain unchanged; this record is a pending regulatory change relevant to the implantable-cardiac-pacemaker condition mapping.
